verdict.rationale: jo is itself a personal agent (per its own docs, an agent running on Mac/cloud with own browser/phone/email), not a platform serving tools to other agents; evidence only shows an OpenAPI spec for its internal API, not an MCP server. Per the agent-role exception, connecting other agents via an official MCP server is a different axis (na) unless jo explicitly runs as an MCP server, which is not evidenced.
